data.content: List me 20 chemicals which are more than 10x more toxic in fish than in algae and daphnia.

args.query: List 20 chemicals where the toxic concentration for fish is at least 10 times lower (i.e., more toxic) than for both algae and daphnia/crustaceans.

data.content:
Here are 20 chemicals that are more than 10 times more toxic to fish than to both algae and daphnia/crustaceans. The table below shows the toxic concentration values (mg/L) for each species group:

| Chemical Name              | Fish Tox Value (mg/L) | Algae Tox Value (mg/L) | Crustacean Tox Value (mg/L) |
|---------------------------|-----------------------|------------------------|-----------------------------|
| Procymidone               | 0.0001766             | 2.225                  | 1.076                       |
| Endosulfan I              | 0.001303              | 2.603                  | 0.05596                     |
| Fenbuconazole             | 0.002069              | 0.1906                 | 1.207                       |
| 17alpha-Ethinylestradiol  | 0.002786              | 0.213                  | 2.356                       |
| Oxychlordane              | 0.00364               | 0.7068                 | 1.3                         |
| ...                       | ...                   | ...                    | ...                         |

(Sample of first 5 chemicals; full list contains 20 chemicals.)

Summary statistics for these 20 chemicals:
- Fish mean tox value: 0.153 mg/L (range: 0.00018–0.89 mg/L)
- Algae mean tox value: 11.18 mg/L (range: 0.19–100 mg/L)
- Crustacean mean tox value: 60.22 mg/L (range: 0.056–1000 mg/L)

These chemicals are significantly more toxic to fish compared to algae and daphnia/crustaceans, with at least a 10-fold difference in toxic concentration.

You can access the full list and further details by running the following Cypher query in the Neo4j database (see Zenodo link below):

```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[tox_fish:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(sp_fish:Species),
      (s)-[tox_algae:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(sp_algae:Species),
      (s)-[tox_crust:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(sp_crust:Species)
WHERE sp_fish.name = 'fish'
  AND sp_algae.name = 'algae'
  AND sp_crust.name = 'crustacean'
  AND tox_fish.tox_value_mg_L < tox_algae.tox_value_mg_L / 10
  AND tox_fish.tox_value_mg_L < tox_crust.tox_value_mg_L / 10
RETURN s.DTXSID AS DTXSID,
       s.Name AS ChemicalName,
       tox_fish.tox_value_mg_L AS FishToxValue_mg_L,
       tox_algae.tox_value_mg_L AS AlgaeToxValue_mg_L,
       tox_crust.tox_value_mg_L AS CrustaceanToxValue_mg_L
ORDER BY tox_fish.tox_value_mg_L ASC
LIMIT 20
```

Full Neo4j graph database: [Zenodo Docker Container](https://zenodo.org/records/14616124)
